summary.intent: Determine whether Phase 72 needed a discuss step before planning, reconcile stale/missing todos against Phases 70/70.1/71, then run the full plan→execute→ship flow for Phase 72 (with Phase 73 to follow once merged).
summary.outcome: Resolved todo drift (8 Phase 71 todos retired, 2 new todos folded into 72/73), diagnosed and fixed three unrelated CI regressions from Phase 70.1/71 fallout (merged as PR #601 and #600), then completed Phase 72 planning (10 plans/8 waves, committed) and drove execution through Wave 4 of 6 (6/10 plans landed, SC#1/#2/#3/#4/#5/#6 groundwork in progress) before the transcript ends mid-Wave-4.

repo: cipher-box repo closes todos by deleting the pending file and adding a completed/ copy — check completed/, not a resolved/ folder (which doesn't exist).

ci-e2e.yml (Web/Desktop E2E) triggers only on push-to-main or workflow_dispatch, never on pull_request — PR checks never exercise it; must dispatch manually with `gh workflow run <file> --ref <branch>` (not `-f ref=`, which 422s on older workflow definitions lacking that input).

Playwright web-e2e's `ciFloor()` helper only raises wait timeouts (e.g. waitForItemToDisappear) to 60s under CI — locally they stay at their base (often 15-30s), so IPNS-gated mutations that are fine in CI can flake locally on a loaded machine.

To verify web-e2e fixes locally under the real CI timeout regime, set CI=1 — but this also flips playwright.config.ts's webServer.reuseExistingServer (`!process.env.CI`), so it will refuse to reuse an already-running dev stack; must temporarily patch reuseExistingServer or start fresh.

Phase 71 (#599) renamed share DTO fields (readDescriptorRef→encryptedReadKey, rootIpnsName→shareRootIpnsName) but left desktop-e2e's shared-scope-exit-rotation.mts test driver using the old names, causing 400s via the API's forbidNonWhitelisted ValidationPipe.

Phase 70.1 collapsed IndexedDB stores generation-high-water + seq-high-water into a single rotation-floor store (DB cipherbox-rotation-state v2, keyed by nodeId) but rotation-durability.spec.ts's test helper wasn't updated to match.

Root `pnpm typecheck` (and CI's Typecheck job) only runs each package's tsconfig.build.json, which excludes test files — vitest transpiles tests without typechecking, so vitest-v2→v3 Mock-generics drift (~50+ errors across sdk-core/sdk/api-client test files) is invisible in CI despite `tsc --noEmit` against the base tsconfig catching it.
pnpm monorepo git worktrees lack node_modules by default — a known failure mode that makes worktree-isolated parallel execution unreliable for phases serialized on shared files like client.ts.
`publish_with_cas_retry` (crates/fuse/src/metadata.rs) is the shared CAS helper for both file-publish and folder(bin)-publish paths; only two real callers exist.

code.finding: publish_file_node hardcoded seq=1 on the first-publish branch gated only by 'inode cid empty'; a dropped/stale UploadComplete re-running that branch re-seals at seq=1 with a new CID, tripping Phase 71's anti-equivocation gate. Fixed by resolving IPNS before first-publish and routing Found outcomes into the existing CAS bump path instead of skipping.

publish_with_cas_retry gained an optional preresolved_seq param so a caller that already resolved the sequence (e.g. content_ops.rs's Found path) skips a redundant second resolve; conflict-retry path still always re-resolves since a pre-resolved value is stale after conflict.

6.6.2 restore-version test had a no-op wait gate (getVersionCount()===1 is true both before and after a restore swap), so the editor read raced the restore's IPNS republish; fixed with expect.poll() re-reading actual content.
Text editor always re-resolves file content fresh from the live API on open (no in-memory current-CID cache), which is why the restore-version test needed a poll rather than a cache-invalidation fix.

workflow: When a CI workflow only runs on push/dispatch, validate fixes pre-merge via workflow_dispatch against the fix branch rather than merging blind.

When two in-flight PRs touch overlapping subsystems, rebase the later branch onto main after the first merges before dispatching a validation run — otherwise the dispatched run tests a stale combination.

Diagnose flaky test failures by checking whether the same spec fails across repeated runs (deterministic bug) vs a different spec each time (suite-level flakiness) before deciding fix-at-source vs treating as noise.
Respect a documented retries:0 test philosophy: even under repeated local flakes, prefer root-causing and fixing each timeout/race at source over adding retry config.

Capture out-of-scope-but-real findings as a durable todo file immediately (before they're lost to context) rather than just mentioning them in a summary, especially when deferring the fix to a later plan/wave.

friction: Hook capability JSON (plan:pre fragments) contains raw multiline strings that break standard JSON.parse; required writing a custom lenient parser (two attempts) to extract research/tdd/schema-gate fragments.
Confusing/contradictory git state checks (cat-file said todos weren't in HEAD, git status said only deletions pending) required a decisive re-check to resolve — wasted a round of investigation.

Local web-e2e verification cascaded through flake after flake (4.10 batch-delete, then 4.11 batch-move, then 2.1 create-folder) across 7 separate local run attempts before reaching the actual target tests (6.6.2, 8.2), because local timeouts aren't floored like CI's.
`git commit` hung for 2 minutes on lint-staged, apparently due to a 1Password SSH-signing prompt; had to verify out-of-band whether the commit actually landed rather than retry blindly.
gh workflow dispatch rejected `-f ref=` with HTTP 422 because the workflow file on main predated that input; required switching to `--ref <branch>`.
Executor subagents for 72-03 and 72-05 couldn't access `.env` in their sandbox, deferring live sdk-e2e confirmation to the orchestrator/phase-verification stage.
CI=1 locally conflicted with playwright's reuseExistingServer config, requiring a temporary (reverted) patch to playwright.config.ts just to get a representative local CI-timeout-regime run.
